messages:
sam-sales: Urgent: Hygea Health (enterprise payer) wants an exec bridge. CISO asking for BYO-KMS + dedicated peering + a guaranteed pilot throughput SLA. They also requested a pilot discount tied to reserved capacity. Need a one-pager of blockers and timelines before 11:30 PT sync.
lee-se: Can we confirm what they mean by guaranteed throughput? p99 latency SLA or a provisioned reserved pool? Pricing differs a lot.
nina-eng: From infra: BYO-KMS is supported but requires keywrap flow and attestation checks. Peering requires BGP + IP allowlist + MTU validation. Rough timeline: peering + initial certs ~48-72 hours; full BYO attestation + legal ~3-5 business days.
ara-legal: If they insist on BYO keys, legal needs to review custody model and may ask for a KMS addendum. Also check exportability of audit logs. Send their questionnaire sections on keys & logs.
jules-cs: I'll draft two POC tracks for the one-pager: (A) Fast: our KMS + peering (48h). (B) BYO KMS + peering (3-5 business days + legal). Include cost delta and ops uplift.
sam-sales: Finance asked for a quick reserved vs on-demand delta for a 4-week 50 rps pilot. Can someone provide a back-of-envelope?
lee-se: Ballpark: reserved commit can be ~35-45% cheaper for steady load. For a short pilot we can offer a -20% incentive on reserved to close; will need revenue approval. I'll add numbers.
nina-eng: Deliverables for bridge: network diagram (peering + CIDRs), KMS integration flow, failover plan, and a short runbook. Adding a sample verification snippet:
```
# peering verify
show bgp neighbors | include hygea
traceroute 10.11.12.1
iperf3 -c 10.11.12.1 -t 10
```
ara-legal: I'll annotate their security questionnaire and flag items requiring contract changes.
jules-cs: Running a quick micro-run to capture latency/token-cost variance between hosted vs reserved; will add a slide.
scheduler-bot: Exec bridge scheduled 2026-05-14 11:30 PT. Invitees: sam-sales, lee-se, nina-eng, ara-legal, jules-cs, hygea-ciso. Meeting link created.
sam-sales: Owners: Lee (pricing delta by 10:30), Nina (infra docs by 10:30), Ara (legal notes by 10:00), Jules (POC slide by 10:45). I'll assemble one-pager at 10:50 and post to exec channel. Ping me if blocked. :thumbsup:
